answer_1.quote: We introduce two controllable text-to-text generation tasks on the dataset: (1) generating and (2) reframing unhelpful thoughts, given a persona and pattern as the context.
answer_1.outputs: Generated unhelpful thoughts and reframed versions

answer_2.quote: we report BLEU, ROUGE, and BERTScore, which capture the semantic similarity between the generated thought and the human reference. We also report distinct-1, and distinct-2 metrics to measure the diversity of the generations.

answer_4.quote: we also perform human evaluation. We collect human ratings of 100 random thoughts from the test set. Similar to previous style transfer works, we evaluate the generated rewrites along three dimensions through Yes/No binary ratings: (i) fluency, which evaluates the readability of the generation, (ii) meaning preservation, which here verifies if the rewrite aligns with the given persona and thought, and (iii) quality, which here evaluates if the generated thought exhibits the given unhelpful thought pattern.
answer_4.guideline: Used Yes/No binary ratings to evaluate fluency, meaning preservation, and quality.
